description: The newest SEC filing per company per form, for up to 50 companies in ONE call: ticker, cik, form (as filed, `10-Q/A` when an amendment is the newest), accession and SEC `accepted_at`. Pass base forms (`10-K`, `10-Q`, `8-K`, `20-F`, `40-F`); amendments count toward their base form. If ANY company cannot be read the answer is `readable: false` (rows that were read still return; `unreadable_tickers` names them): that means 'could not look', never 'filed nothing'. An identifier that matches no company is listed in `unknown_tickers`, and a company outside your plan in `not_on_plan`; neither is a read failure. A ticker that may be a share class, or that more than one company has held, is listed in `unresolved_tickers` (the note names the candidate CIKs): pass its CIK. Available on all plans. Free-plan freshness: sample and sp500 (Benchmark) data lists the day's filings at end of day (20:00 America/New_York), not in real time; real-time filing data is a Pro/Institutional feature.

forms.description: Base form codes, e.g. ['10-K', '10-Q']. A trailing /A is folded into the base form.

name: latest_filings

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

not_on_plan.description: Real companies outside the caller's plan. Present only when non-empty.

note.description: Present when a company could not be answered (unknown, outside the plan, unresolved or unreadable): which, and why.

unknown_tickers.description: Identifiers that match no company. Present only when non-empty.

unreadable_tickers.description: Companies whose filings could not be read (retry). Present only when non-empty; `readable` is then false.

unresolved_tickers.description: Tickers that may be a share class (e.g. GOOG, BRK-A) or that more than one company has held (the note names the candidate CIKs): pass the company's CIK. Present only when non-empty; `readable` is then false.

title: Latest Filings
